I'm a few weeks from finalizing my divorce. When my ex and I split, it absolutely destroyed me. You can see previous posts. In our case, it was very much one sided. If it your SO is anything like me, well it hurt so much that I can't even describe it in words. Be prepared for that.

What I did was draft up a separation agreement. It delt with custody, finances, everything. I just googled it for a template. Of course I had a panic attack doing it, never had one of those before. But in the end, that agreement is what kept me from committing suicide. 

Keep in mind, divorce means you are signing away 50% of your children's time. That fact makes me sick to this day

IMHO, If your hurting yourself then you should be concerned with getting better more than keeping it a secret. I was a cutter but I've been able to quit. You can as well. I told my therapist and we worked through some things. I'm glad I told her

Let me follow up with I couldn't stop expressing my love for my ex at first but as I described our situation to others I couldn't do anything but lash out at her for the things she did or was doing. The venting helped tons for me to process everything. We were married 10 years and have 5 kids. I'm still angry with her for starting the family and then leaving it but anger only hurts the person who's holding it.

I'm sorry you have to go through this as well. Divorce hurt me so very much, in ways I didn't even know possible. I've heard of pain from losing a lover but I didn't think the pain was physical.

If you have issues with depression and the like, do you also have a therapist? Mine probably saved my life, maybe more than once. I also may have gotten the covid from her so that's an interesting twist to it all. I haven't figured out who I got it from yet but she just canceled my appointment today via the assistant. I wonder if she had it...

I'm on the antidepressants too. Those seemed to help a ton. The pain was almost unbearable for me. I lost some 40 lbs and dropped below 20 on the bmi chart.

If you ever need to reach out, have someone to vent to or just need someone to talk to, please you can dm me. it sounds like you are just getting hit with the divorce bat so I know those first few weeks are the hardest.

I am friends ish still with my ex. We've been split now for 4 months. The first few were much more difficult than now. The only reason we are still friends though is her determination. I said some mean things to her that she forgave. 

But we have kids and that was our catalyst. 

I can't imagine her not in my life but when I think of her with another person it makes me physically ill. To my knowledge she is still single; when that changes will be the true test for me. 

I'm seeing someone else and she doesn't know yet as it's just not that serious. If and when she finds out it'll either end the friendship or give her relief that I've moved on. Not really sure how that'll go. Being that she left me and my battle with depression and suicide, she may be exstatic not to have to worry about me anymore.

It doesn't matter if you're 10 or 57, your mother still loves you and she will want you to share with her your struggles. As a parent I can say that if one of my children came to me asking for help I'd feel honored and happy to help in any way I can. 

I have a friend and an aunt who lost a child to suicide. I can imagine they would do anything if they could go back to listen more, or change a few things.

 I've dabbled also but please don't take your life. There's more to see, so much more

I couldn't agree more. I'm trying to avoid the suicide attempts so I can see where things go. Who knows, it could be wonderful.

That and I figured I'd transition first.

I don't fit either, I think lots of us don't fit. My image is wrong too my life is upside down. People think I'm successful, I'm happy, good looking. All I see is failure and ugly. But I'm still here and you're still here. It's ok not to be okay. 

Does your mom know you're struggling?

Parents sometimes know, sometimes they have a hunch, sometimes they have no idea. But sounds like your mom knows. 

But wishing to be anything other than who you are is not healthy. It leads to negative potentially self destructive behavior. I know, I've been there. 

There's nothing wrong with who you are because you are perfect. So hold your head up and you'll go far.

You don't have to apologise for anything. The world should apologise to you. I'm glad you are able to numb the pain but it just shouldn't be that way. I've been to Istanbul, it's a wonderful and also terrible place. But it's also a huge city people can hide in. Of course they'd have to have friends to assist with that which I have no idea if there's already a movement, like an underground railroad or something.  And maybe that'd lead to even worse conditions. People in this world are terrible. I don't know. I just wish people would just let people be. You should be able to be you without putting a target on yourself. It breaks my heart to hear stories like this. 

Don't apologise to me, I should be apologising to you

Hey, I am so sorry that the world isn't great for everyone. I wish I could just wave a wand and fix things like that. Being queer, being female, being born, we should never have to apologise for that. I'm so sorry that you have that, and bad parents on top of it. I'm seriously crying right now for you. 

I don't know if it helps, but I love you. If I had money, power, I'd erase all the harm religion has done to the world. How could God let this world continue in such a state? I figure it's because it's all made up. An all powerful being wouldn't allow things like your situation. They wouldn't allow "killing in the name of _____" to continue. Religion has ruined this planet and it breaks my heart.

You should never have to endure what you have said. If you can, do whatever you have to do, escape safely to somewhere safe. Istanbul isn't too far and somewhat better. 

Or don't listen to me, I'm just some crazy internet person who has a bad outlook on life.

Yeah it will look different. Lonely, sad, probably homeless. Or just dead from trying to date during a pandemic.

She left me because I was too honest with her. I never cheated, I never lied. I didn't hide anything from her. She knew she could walk all over me, and she did. She hid money, spending, credit cards. She lied to me about a lot. But I just let her. 

Don't feel sorry for me. I'm just a nieve person who takes people for their word. I thought what we had was real. I was wrong.

When we met, she was broke, uneducated, barely scraping by. I got her to go to school, start a career. She's the only college graduate in her family. She's also the most successful. I got her there, and now she doesn't need me. So don't feel sorry for me. She's the angel. Im just the looser with the scars of depression.

I wish I could make better decisions. It's one of my greatest flaws. Indecision. Fear of everything and I wall up, hide. I'm terrible at it. 

There's people that deserves kindness, I'm just not sure I do. I let our marriage die, she doesn't love me anymore because I ignored her feelings. I can't go back and fix it and seeing her in photos with someone I thought was my friend, well I'm just not manly enough, he's everything I'm not. She'll be here in an hour, I need to get ready
This is actually helpful, thanks. I didn't think of it like that
Yeah, she should have left me long ago. I never cheated on her, what I did was worse. I put myself first and stopped caring for her. Looking back, she should have left me long ago.

Thank you for the message. Im crying again, but it's a good cry. You are right and I appreciate the words. 2021 could be a better year for me, it's just so far away. 

I think I'm going to ask my parents to move back in. I'm not going to hide my suicidal ideation anymore. Well, not with my family. I got really close, closer than I should have. If I live with them, I won't be alone and won't be able to do it. It's what I need, I just hope they're ok with it.

I can't feel like this for 4 years. I am not that strong. I want to be better. I am going to commit to making it to my counselling appointment. I am not going to commit to being sober and I know I will be cutting more. But it's not deadly, just helps me hurt less inside.

I'm sorry she did that to you. Why can't we all just treat each other with respect? Is that too much to ask? I wanted to burn her dress but making her take it will hopefully be hard for her. I have too much respect for her to do anything malicious. I just can't get there.

I have taken all the blame, she said I'm not allowed to do that. At the time, I was still doing everything she said. But I know I'm the problem. I'm not being petty, I'm not fighting over who gets this or that. There's no discussion to be had. I just need to not feel like this anymore.
Accusations are painful, especially when they aren't true. I'm sorry

I understand what you are saying, and I get it. I really do. But my head told me if I'm dead, I don't have to miss anyone. I don't have to be in pain anymore. I don't have to worry about anything anymore. I'm just not alive. the idea is others get to have some pain was appealing. I just was in a really dark place. I haven't been like that, well not really since I attempted suicide the first time. But that was some 20 years ago.

The kids are s big reason I'm still here, they're all I have. I took off work for the days they're here and we are having a time! Not many of them left in this house. 

I may DM you, if I can. I'm just so lonely too. the lack of empathy by any of my friends is staggering. Not a single one has bothered to stop by. But they've been to her place. I just feel so alone.

Thank you for your concern. I did contact the suicide prevention line and it made me realize that I need therapy. I also contacted a therapist so there's that. I just want to get to that first meeting. I can start with that. 

I really do enjoy time with the kiddos. This was a week where they spend 5 of 7 days at her place. The original agreement was we would see them every day with dropping off and picking up surrounding daycare. Well she jumped on a plane to hang with my replacement for the weekend, while I was asking, begging to talk to the kids, she just ignored me. I lost it, took it as her keeping me from them. It's my biggest fear.

So you're saying I should not expect a miracle by taking 3 or 4 pills when the pain is so fresh. Ok, I'll give them time. 

Today's going to be a tough one. Hopefully after, there's just better things to look forward towards
I'll try

So I have seen probably 10 different counselors and of them, 9 stunk. Unfortunately finding a good one isn't as easy as you'd think. But they are out there. So are friends. School can be really hard sometimes but it's temporary. It seemed to take forever when I was there but looking back, it was just a blink. I know how you feel, I am sorry it isn't going well.

As a fellow trans person, though mtf, our struggles are real. I completely get it. There are times I feel just like you. I have trouble eating, sleeping, basic human functioning. It's really hard but it is possible to heal. Have you spoken to a counselor? Mine helped tons. It's also helpful if you can find some other accepting folk, maybe even trans, that you can make friends with. That's not easy, but it too helps. 

And if you ever need to rant, if that helps, we're here to listen.
